diagnostics.other_language: This saved report uses another language. Changing the interface does not translate reports or call AI. Select a report above, or explicitly start a new diagnosis with your chosen AI output language.
diagnostics.completed_actions_unverified: Diagnosis completed; safe actions executed, resolution not verified
diagnostics.snapshot_warning: Historical snapshot, not a live health check. Completed does not mean every problem was fixed.
diagnostics.invalid_payload: The model did not return executable JSON. Automatic actions stopped.
diagnostics.no_structured_actions: No structured actions were returned by advanced diagnostics.
diagnostics.stale_found: Tasks have not updated for a long time. Try deterministic stale-state recovery first.
diagnostics.queue_idle: Tasks are queued but no batch is running. Start queue dispatch.
diagnostics.no_safe_action: No issue suitable for safe automatic handling was found.
diagnostics.check_tasks_restart: Check the task center. If the API is unavailable, restart the service using the launcher's stop/start commands.
imports.busy: Another import is running. Wait for it to finish before importing again.
imports.active_tasks: AI tasks are active or queued. Finish or cancel them before importing. Read-only preview remains available.
imports.preview_too_large: This preview exceeds 200,000 rows. Split the transfer into smaller files.
imports.preview_timeout: Read-only preview reached its 20-second limit and stopped without writing data. Split the transfer into smaller files.
